capabilities: Fuzzy-search note titles, aliases, headings, tags, paths, properties and content in weighted tiers
Preview the selected note with highlighted, jumpable matches
Show similar notes and guard note creation against near-duplicates
Create notes or unresolved-link ghosts from the query with Shift+Enter
Narrow queries with phrase, #tag, path:, property and type: syntax
extras: Fully local, no network and no AI model; the semantic tier only reuses embeddings Smart Connections already computed. Requires Obsidian 1.5.7+ (1.13+ for settings search). Detailed performance and comparison write-ups live in docs/performance.md and docs/comparison.md; at ~100k notes the worker uses about 2.3 GB of memory.
intentEvidence: i integrated Quick Seach, OMniseach and Smart Connections into one Plugin
motivation: The author used Omnisearch for 5+ years, missed notes it should have found, found its title/heading/body weighting unclear, and separately relied on the Smart Connections panel to avoid creating duplicate notes in a folder-less vault.
problem: Obsidian's native search and Quick Switcher become slow and unranked in very large vaults, and fuzzy matching, note preview and duplicate detection live in separate tools.
